answer.summary: Two ArchUnit tests in TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest fail deterministically. The change makes LocalObjectService inject AttackPatternRepository and VulnerabilityRepository directly, and the architecture rules forbid that access outside the reviewed services. Re-running will fail the same way until the repository access is moved behind an allowed service or the rule is reviewed. Unrelated infrastructure noise in the log (the Crowdstrike JSON parse error, the exception-dump fixtures) is not the cause.
